preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200000.
The number of nodes N must be between 2 and 200000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(S) == N and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must have exactly N characters, each being a lowercase English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes and no node can connect to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N and U != V for U, V in queries)
preconditions.description: All queries must involve valid nodes and no node can be queried with itself.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(is_palindrome(subseq) for subseq in generate_subsequences(DIS(V, LCA(U, V)))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each query, output 'YES' if there exists a concatenation of non-empty subsequences from DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) that forms a palindrome; otherwise, output 'NO'.
